Module 09: Named-Entity Markup: Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Identify the people, places, organizations and dates in a historical document, and say when a name is ambiguous.
  • Encode them with <persName>, <placeName>, <orgName> and <date @when>, linking each to an authority record (Wikidata, VIAF, GeoNames) with @ref.
  • Run automated entity recognition and gazetteer lookup, and measure its precision and recall against your hand tagging.
  • Audit AI-assisted entity tagging and linking for invented identifiers and wrong matches, recording a verified absence where no authority record exists.
